verses.original: חַטַּ֣את יְהוּדָ֗ה כְּתוּבָ֛ה בְּעֵ֥ט בַּרְזֶ֖ל בְּצִפֹּ֣רֶן שָׁמִ֑יר חֲרוּשָׁה֙ עַל־ ל֣וּחַ לִבָּ֔ם וּלְקַרְנ֖וֹת מִזְבְּחוֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ḥaṭ·ṭaṯ yə·hū·ḏāh kə·ṯū·ḇāh bə·‘êṭ bar·zel bə·ṣip·pō·ren šā·mîr ḥă·rū·šāh ‘al- lū·aḥ lib·bām ū·lə·qar·nō·wṯ miz·bə·ḥō·w·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: The sin of Judah is written with an iron stylus engraved with a diamond point on the tablets of their hearts and on the horns of their altars
verses.literalPt: O pecado de Judá está escrito com um ponteiro de ferro e com a ponta dum diamante; gravado está na tábua do seu coração e nos chifres dos vossos altares.

verses.original: כִּזְכֹּ֤ר בְּנֵיהֶם֙ מִזְבְּחוֹתָ֔ם וַאֲשֵׁרֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־ עֵ֣ץ רַֽעֲנָ֑ן עַ֖ל גְּבָע֥וֹת הַגְּבֹהֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: kiz·kōr bə·nê·hem miz·bə·ḥō·w·ṯām wa·’ă·šê·rê·hem ‘al- ‘êṣ ra·‘ă·nān ‘al gə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ hag·gə·ḇō·hō·wṯ
verses.literal: Even their children remember their altars and Asherah poles by the green trees and on the high hills
verses.literalPt: enquanto os seus filhos se lembram dos seus altares, e dos seus Aserins junto às árvores frondosas, sobre os altos outeiros.

verses.original: הֲרָרִי֙ בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה חֵילְךָ֥ כָל־ אוֹצְרוֹתֶ֖יךָ לָבַ֣ז אֶתֵּ֑ן בָּמֹתֶ֕יךָ בְּחַטָּ֖את בְּכָל־ גְּבוּלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·rā·rî baś·śā·ḏeh ḥê·lə·ḵā ḵāl ’ō·wṣ·rō·w·ṯe·ḵā lā·ḇaz ’et·tên bā·mō·ṯe·ḵā bə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ bə·ḵāl gə·ḇū·le·ḵā
verses.literal: O My mountain in the countryside I will give over your wealth and all your treasures as plunder because of the sin of your high places within all your borders
verses.literalPt: Ó meu monte que te elevas sobre o campo, a tua substância e todos os teus tesouros, bem como os teus altos, dá-los-ei como despojo por causa do pecado, em todos os teus termos.

verses.original: וְשָׁמַטְתָּ֗ה וּבְךָ֙ מִנַּחֲלָֽתְךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣תִּי לָ֔ךְ וְהַעֲבַדְתִּ֙יךָ֙ אֶת־ אֹ֣יְבֶ֔יךָ בָּאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ יָדָ֑עְתָּ כִּֽי־ אֵ֛שׁ קְדַחְתֶּ֥ם בְּאַפִּ֖י עַד־ עוֹלָ֥ם תּוּקָֽד׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·maṭ·tāh ū·ḇə·ḵā min·na·ḥă·lā·ṯə·ḵā ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tî lāḵ wə·ha·‘ă·ḇaḏ·tî·ḵā ’eṯ- ’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā bā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer lō- yā·ḏā·‘ə·tā kî- ’êš qə·ḏaḥ·tem bə·’ap·pî ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām tū·qāḏ
verses.literal: And you yourself will relinquish the inheritance that I gave you I will enslave you to your enemies in a land that you do not know for you have kindled . . . My anger it will burn forever . . .
verses.literalPt: Tu abandonarás a tua herança que te dei, e farei que sirvas aos teus inimigos na terra que não conheces; porque ateaste um fogo na minha ira, o qual arderá para sempre.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אָר֤וּר הַגֶּ֙בֶר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִבְטַ֣ח בָּֽאָדָ֔ם וְשָׂ֥ם בָּשָׂ֖ר זְרֹע֑וֹ וּמִן־ יְהוָ֖ה יָס֥וּר לִבּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ā·rūr hag·ge·ḇer ’ă·šer yiḇ·ṭaḥ bā·’ā·ḏām wə·śām bā·śār zə·rō·‘ōw ū·min- Yah·weh yā·sūr lib·bōw
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says Cursed is the man who trusts in mankind who makes mere flesh his strength and turns his heart from the LORD
verses.literalPt: Assim diz Jeová: Maldito é o homem que confia no homem, põe a carne por seu braço e cujo coração se desvia de Jeová!

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ כְּעַרְעָ֣ר בָּֽעֲרָבָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א יִרְאֶ֖ה כִּי־ יָב֣וֹא ט֑וֹב וְשָׁכַ֤ן חֲרֵרִים֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר אֶ֥רֶץ מְלֵחָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א תֵשֵֽׁב׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kə·‘ar·‘ār bā·‘ă·rā·ḇāh wə·lō yir·’eh kî- yā·ḇō·w ṭō·wḇ wə·šā·ḵan ḥă·rê·rîm bam·miḏ·bār ’e·reṣ mə·lê·ḥāh wə·lō ṯê·šêḇ
verses.literal: He will be like a shrub in the desert he will not see when prosperity comes He will dwell in the parched places of the desert in a salt land where no one lives
verses.literalPt: Porque será como o junípero no deserto e não verá quando vier o bem; mas habitará nos lugares áridos do ermo, numa terra de salsugem e despovoada.

verses.original: בָּר֣וּךְ הַגֶּ֔בֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִבְטַ֖ח בַּֽיהוָ֑ה וְהָיָ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה מִבְטַחֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bā·rūḵ hag·ge·ḇer ’ă·šer yiḇ·ṭaḥ Yah·weh wə·hā·yāh Yah·weh miḇ·ṭa·ḥōw
verses.literal: But blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD whose confidence is in Him
verses.literalPt: Bendito é o homem que confia em Jeová e de quem Jeová é a confiança!

verses.original: וְהָיָ֞ה כְּעֵ֣ץ׀ שָׁת֣וּל עַל־ מַ֗יִם וְעַל־ יוּבַל֙ יְשַׁלַּ֣ח שָֽׁרָשָׁ֔יו וְלֹ֤א יִרָא כִּֽי־ יָבֹ֣א חֹ֔ם וְהָיָ֥ה עָלֵ֖הוּ רַֽעֲנָ֑ן וּבִשְׁנַ֤ת בַּצֹּ֙רֶת֙ לֹ֣א יִדְאָ֔ג וְלֹ֥א יָמִ֖ישׁ מֵעֲשׂ֥וֹת פֶּֽרִי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kə·‘êṣ šā·ṯūl ‘al- ma·yim wə·‘al- yū·ḇal yə·šal·laḥ šā·rā·šāw wə·lō yi·rå̄ kî- yā·ḇō ḥōm wə·hā·yāh ‘ā·lê·hū ra·‘ă·nān ū·ḇiš·naṯ baṣ·ṣō·reṯ lō yiḏ·’āḡ wə·lō yā·mîš mê·‘ă·śō·wṯ pe·rî
verses.literal: He is like a tree planted by the waters that sends out its roots . . . toward the stream It does not fear when the heat comes and its leaves are always green It does not worry . . . in a year of drought nor does it cease to produce fruit
verses.literalPt: Porque será como a árvore plantada junto às águas, que estende as suas raízes à margem dum ribeiro; não temerá quando vier o calor, mas a sua folha será verde; no ano de seca, não andará cuidadoso, nem deixará de dar fruto.

verses.original: עָקֹ֥ב הַלֵּ֛ב מִכֹּ֖ל וְאָנֻ֣שׁ ה֑וּא מִ֖י יֵדָעֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·qōḇ hal·lêḇ mik·kōl wə·’ā·nuš hū mî yê·ḏā·‘en·nū
verses.literal: The heart is deceitful above all things and beyond cure . . . Who can understand it
verses.literalPt: Enganoso é o coração acima de todas as coisas e gravemente enfermo; quem o poderá conhecer?

verses.original: אֲנִ֧י יְהוָ֛ה חֹקֵ֥ר לֵ֖ב בֹּחֵ֣ן כְּלָי֑וֹת וְלָתֵ֤ת לְאִישׁ֙ כְּדַרְכּוֹ כִּפְרִ֖י מַעֲלָלָֽיו׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî Yah·weh ḥō·qêr lêḇ bō·ḥên kə·lā·yō·wṯ wə·lā·ṯêṯ lə·’îš kə·ḏar·kō kip̄·rî ma·‘ă·lā·lāw
verses.literal: I the LORD search the heart I examine the mind to reward a man according to his way by what his deeds deserve
verses.literalPt: Eu, Jeová, esquadrinho o coração, provo os rins, para dar a cada um segundo os seus caminhos, segundo o fruto dos seus feitos.

verses.original: קֹרֵ֤א דָגַר֙ וְלֹ֣א יָלָ֔ד עֹ֥שֶׂה עֹ֖שֶׁר וְלֹ֣א בְמִשְׁפָּ֑ט בַּחֲצִ֤י יֹמוֹ יַעַזְבֶ֔נּוּ וּבְאַחֲרִית֖וֹ יִהְיֶ֥ה נָבָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: qō·rê ḏā·ḡar wə·lō yā·lāḏ ‘ō·śeh ‘ō·šer wə·lō ḇə·miš·pāṭ ba·ḥă·ṣî yō·mō ya·‘az·ḇen·nū ū·ḇə·’a·ḥă·rî·ṯōw yih·yeh nā·ḇāl
verses.literal: Like a partridge hatching eggs it did not lay is the man who makes a fortune unjustly In the middle of his days his riches will desert him and in the end he will be the fool
verses.literalPt: Como a perdiz que ajunta pintainhos que não são do seu ninho, assim é o que ajunta riquezas, porém não com direito; no meio dos seus dias, as deixará, e, no seu fim, se mostrará insensato.

verses.original: כִּסֵּ֣א כָב֔וֹד מָר֖וֹם מֵֽרִאשׁ֑וֹן מְק֖וֹם מִקְדָּשֵֽׁנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kis·sê ḵā·ḇō·wḏ mā·rō·wm mê·ri·šō·wn mə·qō·wm miq·dā·šê·nū
verses.literal: A glorious throne exalted from the beginning is the place of our sanctuary
verses.literalPt: Um trono de glória, exaltado desde o princípio, é o lugar do nosso santuário.

verses.original: מִקְוֵ֤ה יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יְהוָ֔ה כָּל־ עֹזְבֶ֖יךָ יֵבֹ֑שׁוּ יִסּוֹרַי בָּאָ֣רֶץ יִכָּתֵ֔בוּ כִּ֥י עָזְב֛וּ מְק֥וֹר מַֽיִם־ חַיִּ֖ים אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: miq·wêh yiś·rā·’êl Yah·weh kāl- ‘ō·zə·ḇe·ḵā yê·ḇō·šū yis·sō·ray bā·’ā·reṣ yik·kā·ṯê·ḇū kî ‘ā·zə·ḇū mə·qō·wr ma·yim- ḥay·yîm ’eṯ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: O LORD the hope of Israel all who abandon You will be put to shame All who turn away will be written in the dust for they have abandoned the LORD the fountain of living water
verses.literalPt: Ó Jeová, Esperança de Israel! Todos os que te abandonarem serão envergonhados; os que se desviarem de ti, serão escritos sobre a terra, porque abandonaram a Jeová, fonte das águas vivas.

verses.original: רְפָאֵ֤נִי יְהוָה֙ וְאֵ֣רָפֵ֔א הוֹשִׁיעֵ֖נִי וְאִוָּשֵׁ֑עָה כִּ֥י תְהִלָּתִ֖י אָֽתָּה׃
verses.transliteration: rə·p̄ā·’ê·nî Yah·weh wə·’ê·rā·p̄ê hō·wō·šî·‘ê·nî wə·’iw·wā·šê·‘āh kî ṯə·hil·lā·ṯî ’āt·tāh
verses.literal: Heal me O LORD and I will be healed save me and I will be saved for You are my praise
verses.literalPt: Cura-me, Jeová, e serei curado; salva-me, e serei salvo, porque tu és o meu louvor.

verses.original: הִנֵּה־ הֵ֕מָּה אֹמְרִ֖ים אֵלָ֑י אַיֵּ֥ה דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה יָ֥בוֹא נָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh- hêm·māh ’ō·mə·rîm ’ê·lāy ’ay·yêh ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh yā·ḇō·w nā
verses.literal: Behold they keep saying to me Where is the word of the LORD Let it come now
verses.literalPt: Eis que eles me dizem: Onde está a palavra de Jeová? Que venha agora!

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֞י לֹא־ אַ֣צְתִּי׀ מֵרֹעֶ֣ה אַחֲרֶ֗יךָ וְי֥וֹם אָנ֛וּשׁ לֹ֥א הִתְאַוֵּ֖יתִי אַתָּ֣ה יָדָ֑עְתָּ מוֹצָ֣א שְׂפָתַ֔י נֹ֥כַח פָּנֶ֖יךָ הָיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî lō- ’aṣ·tî mê·rō·‘eh ’a·ḥă·re·ḵā wə·yō·wm ’ā·nūš lō hiṯ·’aw·wê·ṯî ’at·tāh yā·ḏā·‘ə·tā mō·w·ṣā śə·p̄ā·ṯay nō·ḵaḥ pā·ne·ḵā hā·yāh
verses.literal: But I have not run away from being Your shepherd . . . I have not desired the day of despair You know that the utterance of my lips was spoken in Your presence
verses.literalPt: Quanto a mim, não me apressei em deixar de ser pastor após ti, nem tampouco desejei o dia calamitoso; tu sabes; o que saiu dos meus lábios foi diante da tua face.

verses.original: אַל־ תִּֽהְיֵה־ לִ֖י לִמְחִתָּ֑ה מַֽחֲסִי־ אַ֖תָּה בְּי֥וֹם רָעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tih·yêh- lî lim·ḥit·tāh ma·ḥă·sî- ’at·tāh bə·yō·wm rā·‘āh
verses.literal: Do not become a terror to me You are my refuge in the day of disaster
verses.literalPt: Não me sejas motivo de pavor; meu refúgio és tu no dia da calamidade.

verses.original: יֵבֹ֤שׁוּ רֹדְפַי֙ וְאַל־ אֵבֹ֣שָׁה אָ֔נִי יֵחַ֣תּוּ הֵ֔מָּה וְאַל־ אֵחַ֖תָּה אָ֑נִי הָבִ֤יא עֲלֵיהֶם֙ י֣וֹם רָעָ֔ה וּמִשְׁנֶ֥ה שִׁבָּר֖וֹן שָׁבְרֵֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: yê·ḇō·šū rō·ḏə·p̄ay wə·’al- ’ê·ḇō·šāh ’ā·nî yê·ḥat·tū hêm·māh wə·’al- ’ê·ḥat·tāh ’ā·nî hā·ḇî ‘ă·lê·hem yō·wm rā·‘āh ū·miš·neh šib·bā·rō·wn šā·ḇə·rêm
verses.literal: Let my persecutors be put to shame but do not let me be put to shame Let them be terrified but do not let me be terrified Bring upon them the day of disaster and shatter them with double destruction
verses.literalPt: Sejam envergonhados os que me perseguem, porém não seja eu envergonhado; assombrem-se eles, porém não me assombre eu; faze vir sobre eles o dia da calamidade e quebra-os com dobrado quebrantamento.

verses.original: כֹּה־ אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י הָלֹ֤ךְ וְעָֽמַדְתָּ֙ בְּשַׁ֣עַר בְּנֵֽי־ עָם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָבֹ֤אוּ בוֹ֙ מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וַאֲשֶׁ֖ר יֵ֣צְאוּ ב֑וֹ וּבְכֹ֖ל שַׁעֲרֵ֥י יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ê·lay hā·lōḵ wə·‘ā·maḏ·tā bə·ša·‘ar bə·nê- ʿå̄m ’ă·šer yā·ḇō·’ū ḇōw mal·ḵê yə·hū·ḏāh wa·’ă·šer yê·ṣə·’ū ḇōw ū·ḇə·ḵōl ša·‘ă·rê yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: This is what the LORD said to me Go and stand at the gate of the people . . . through which the kings of Judah go in and out and stand at all the other gates of Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Assim me disse Jeová: Vai e põe-te na porta dos filhos do povo, pela qual entram os reis de Judá e pela qual saem, como também em todas as portas de Jerusalém,

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲ֠לֵיהֶם שִׁמְע֨וּ דְבַר־ יְהוָ֜ה מַלְכֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ וְכָל־ יְהוּדָ֔ה וְכֹ֖ל יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם הַבָּאִ֖ים בַּשְּׁעָרִ֥ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem šim·‘ū ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh mal·ḵê yə·hū·ḏāh wə·ḵāl yə·hū·ḏāh wə·ḵōl yō·šə·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim hab·bā·’îm baš·šə·‘ā·rîm hā·’êl·leh
verses.literal: Say to them Hear the word of the LORD O kings of Judah all people of Judah and . . . Jerusalem who enter through these gates
verses.literalPt: e dize-lhes: Ouvi a palavra de Jeová, reis de Judá, e todo o Judá, e todos os habitantes de Jerusalém que entrais por estas portas.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִשָּׁמְר֖וּ בְּנַפְשֽׁוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וְאַל־ תִּשְׂא֤וּ מַשָּׂא֙ בְּי֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת וַהֲבֵאתֶ֖ם בְּשַׁעֲרֵ֥י יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh hiš·šā·mə·rū bə·nap̄·šō·w·ṯê·ḵem wə·’al- tiś·’ū maś·śā bə·yō·wm haš·šab·bāṯ wa·hă·ḇê·ṯem bə·ša·‘ă·rê yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says Take heed for yourselves do not carry a load or bring it through the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day
verses.literalPt: Assim diz Jeová: Guardai-vos a vós mesmos e não queirais trazer cargas no dia do sábado, nem as introduzais pelas portas de Jerusalém;

verses.original: וְלֹא־ תוֹצִ֨יאוּ מַשָּׂ֤א מִבָּֽתֵּיכֶם֙ בְּי֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת וְכָל־ מְלָאכָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַֽעֲשׂ֑וּ וְקִדַּשְׁתֶּם֙ אֶת־ י֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֖יתִי אֶת־ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ṯō·w·ṣî·’ū maś·śā mib·bāt·tê·ḵem bə·yō·wm haš·šab·bāṯ wə·ḵāl mə·lā·ḵāh lō ṯa·‘ă·śū wə·qid·daš·tem ’eṯ- yō·wm haš·šab·bāṯ ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯî ’eṯ- ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: You must not carry a load out of your houses or do any work on the Sabbath day . . . but you must keep the Sabbath day holy just as I commanded your forefathers
verses.literalPt: nem das vossas casas tireis cargas no dia do sábado, nem façais trabalho algum; antes, santificai o dia do sábado, como ordenei a vossos pais.

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א שָֽׁמְע֔וּ וְלֹ֥א הִטּ֖וּ אֶת־ אָזְנָ֑ם וַיַּקְשׁוּ֙ אֶת־ עָרְפָּ֔ם לְבִלְתִּ֣י שׁוֹמֵעַ וּלְבִלְתִּ֖י קַ֥חַת מוּסָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō šā·mə·‘ū wə·lō hiṭ·ṭū ’eṯ- ’ā·zə·nām way·yaq·šū ’eṯ- ‘ā·rə·pām lə·ḇil·tî šō·mē·aʿ ū·lə·ḇil·tî qa·ḥaṯ mū·sār
verses.literal: Yet they would not listen . . . or incline their ear but they stiffened their necks and would not listen . . . or receive My discipline
verses.literalPt: Porém não escutaram, nem inclinaram os seus ouvidos, mas endureceram a sua cerviz, para não me ouvirem, para não receberem instruções.

verses.original: וְ֠הָיָה אִם־ שָׁמֹ֨עַ תִּשְׁמְע֤וּן אֵלַי֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה לְבִלְתִּ֣י׀ הָבִ֣יא מַשָּׂ֗א בְּשַׁעֲרֵ֛י הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּ֖את בְּי֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֑ת וּלְקַדֵּשׁ֙ אֶת־ י֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת לְבִלְתִּ֥י עֲשֽׂוֹת־ בֹּה כָּל־ מְלָאכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ’im- šā·mō·a‘ tiš·mə·‘ūn ’ê·lay nə·’um- Yah·weh lə·ḇil·tî hā·ḇî maś·śā bə·ša·‘ă·rê hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ bə·yō·wm haš·šab·bāṯ ū·lə·qad·dêš ’eṯ- yō·wm haš·šab·bāṯ lə·ḇil·tî ‘ă·śō·wṯ- bōh kāl- mə·lā·ḵāh
verses.literal: If however you listen carefully . . . to Me says the LORD and bring no load through the gates of this city on the Sabbath day and keep the Sabbath day holy and do no work on it
verses.literalPt: Se diligentemente me ouvirdes, diz Jeová, para não introduzirdes cargas pelas portas desta cidade no dia do sábado, mas para santificardes o dia do sábado, sem fazerdes nele trabalho algum,

verses.original: וּבָ֣אוּ בְשַׁעֲרֵ֣י הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֡את מְלָכִ֣ים׀ וְשָׂרִ֡ים יֹשְׁבִים֩ עַל־ כִּסֵּ֨א דָוִ֜ד רֹכְבִ֣ים׀ בָּרֶ֣כֶב וּבַסּוּסִ֗ים הֵ֚מָּה וְשָׂ֣רֵיהֶ֔ם אִ֥ישׁ יְהוּדָ֖ה וְיֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְיָשְׁבָ֥ה הָֽעִיר־ הַזֹּ֖את לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·’ū ḇə·ša·‘ă·rê hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ mə·lā·ḵîm wə·śā·rîm yō·šə·ḇîm ‘al- kis·sê ḏā·wiḏ rō·ḵə·ḇîm bā·re·ḵeḇ ū·ḇas·sū·sîm hêm·māh wə·śā·rê·hem ’îš yə·hū·ḏāh wə·yō·šə·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim wə·yā·šə·ḇāh hā·‘îr- haz·zōṯ lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: then kings and princes will enter through the gates of this city They will sit on the throne of David riding in chariots and on horses with their officials along with the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem and this city will be inhabited forever
verses.literalPt: pelas portas desta cidade entrarão reis e príncipes, que se assentarão sobre o trono de Davi e andarão em carros e montados em cavalos, eles e os seus príncipes, os homens de Judá e os habitantes de Jerusalém; e esta cidade permanecerá para sempre.

verses.original: וּבָ֣אוּ מֵעָרֵֽי־ יְ֠הוּדָה וּמִסְּבִיב֨וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם וּמֵאֶ֣רֶץ בִּנְיָמִ֗ן וּמִן־ הַשְּׁפֵלָ֤ה וּמִן־ הָהָר֙ וּמִן־ הַנֶּ֔גֶב מְבִאִ֛ים עוֹלָ֥ה וְזֶ֖בַח וּמִנְחָ֣ה וּלְבוֹנָ֑ה וּמְבִאֵ֥י תוֹדָ֖ה בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·’ū mê·‘ā·rê- yə·hū·ḏāh ū·mis·sə·ḇî·ḇō·wṯ yə·rū·šā·lim ū·mê·’e·reṣ bin·yā·min ū·min- haš·šə·p̄ê·lāh ū·min- hā·hār ū·min- han·ne·ḡeḇ mə·ḇi·’îm ‘ō·w·lāh wə·ze·ḇaḥ ū·min·ḥāh ū·lə·ḇō·w·nāh ū·mə·ḇi·’ê ṯō·w·ḏāh bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: And people will come from the cities of Judah and the places around Jerusalem from the land of Benjamin and from the foothills the hill country and the Negev bringing burnt offerings and sacrifices grain offerings and frankincense . . . and thank offerings to the house of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Virão das cidades de Judá, e dos contornos de Jerusalém, e da terra de Benjamim, e da planície, e da região montanhosa, e do Neguebe, trazendo à Casa de Jeová holocaustos, e sacrifícios, e oblações, e incenso, trazendo também sacrifícios de ação de graças.

verses.original: וְאִם־ לֹ֨א תִשְׁמְע֜וּ אֵלַ֗י לְקַדֵּשׁ֙ אֶת־ י֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת וּלְבִלְתִּ֣י׀ שְׂאֵ֣ת מַשָּׂ֗א וּבֹ֛א בְּשַׁעֲרֵ֥י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בְּי֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֑ת וְהִצַּ֧תִּי אֵ֣שׁ בִּשְׁעָרֶ֗יהָ וְאָֽכְלָ֛ה אַרְמְנ֥וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וְלֹ֥א תִכְבֶּֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- lō ṯiš·mə·‘ū ’ê·lay lə·qad·dêš ’eṯ- yō·wm haš·šab·bāṯ ū·lə·ḇil·tî śə·’êṯ maś·śā ū·ḇō bə·ša·‘ă·rê yə·rū·šā·lim bə·yō·wm haš·šab·bāṯ wə·hiṣ·ṣat·tî ’êš biš·‘ā·re·hā wə·’ā·ḵə·lāh ’ar·mə·nō·wṯ yə·rū·šā·lim wə·lō ṯiḵ·beh
verses.literal: But if you do not listen to Me to keep the Sabbath day holy by not carrying a load while entering the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day then I will kindle an unquenchable fire in its gates to consume the citadels of Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Se, porém, não me ouvirdes para santificardes o dia do sábado e para no dia do sábado cessardes de trazer carga e entrar com ela pelas portas de Jerusalém; acenderei fogo nas portas dela, fogo que devorará os palácios de Jerusalém e não se apagará.
